_comment: Machine-readable scope for .claude/hooks/scope-guard.mjs. FILL IN PHASE 0 from notes/program-rules.md. Until inScope has at least one entry the guard is inactive. Patterns: exact host ('api.acme.com'), any-depth subdomain wildcard ('*.acme.com' — does NOT include the apex, list it too), or IPv4 CIDR ('203.0.113.0/24'). outOfScope always wins over inScope. WHITE-BOX: inScope = the lab hosts (localhost is already allowed), and put the program's production domains in outOfScope (lab-only rule).
_outOfScope_note: Include registration-only hosts (used to create accounts, not to test), sister brands, third-party SaaS the target uses, and staging hosts the program didn't list.
_denyUnlisted_note: Domains whose UNLISTED hosts are out of scope, e.g. ['acme.com', '*.acme.com'] when the program says 'any acme.com host not listed is OOS'. Unlike outOfScope, it doesn't override inScope entries. Paths aren't checked: a host-level scope like 'acme.com/portal' must be respected by hand.
_uaTag_note: Exact string every curl/iwr to an in-scope host must carry (e.g. 'BugBounty-yourhandle'). Leave empty if the program doesn't require one.
_requiredHeaders_note: Strings that must appear in every request to an in-scope host, e.g. 'X-Bug-Bounty: yourhandle'.
_confirmStateChanging_note: true = ask before POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE or a request with a body against a live in-scope host (GraphQL queries without 'mutation' don't count).
_requireConfirm_note: true = the guard blocks ALL live testing of in-scope hosts until the current scope is confirmed. After editing inScope/outOfScope/denyUnlisted, review them and run 'bountyproof scope confirm' (or tools/scripts/confirm-scope.ps1) to re-confirm. Any edit invalidates the previous confirmation (ZeroProtocol pattern: widening scope clears it automatically). Black-box workspaces start with true; white-box lab-only work starts with false. Only the human confirms: the scope-guard hook blocks the agent from running the confirm command.
_confirmedScope_note: SHA-256 of the confirmed inScope/outOfScope/denyUnlisted set. Written by 'bountyproof scope confirm' / confirm-scope.ps1 — do NOT edit by hand. When it no longer matches the current scope and requireConfirm=true, the guard denies in-scope requests.
_allowHosts_note: Non-target hosts you legitimately hit with curl (docs, CDNs for tooling). Platform sites, GitHub, npm/pypi, crt.sh and localhost are allowed by default.
_hunterInfra_note: Your own out-of-band endpoints (interactsh/webhook host, your VPS) used as the attacker-controlled side of a PoC.
